title: Trials HD
subtitle: One motorcycle, one difficult line

body: Trials HD is RedLynx's Xbox Live Arcade motorcycle game, released on 12 August 2009. A rider crosses obstacle courses shown from the side, using throttle, braking and body position to keep the bike moving towards the finish. The route is easy to understand and often difficult to complete. A wheel placed slightly too far forward can turn a promising attempt into another crash. Three-dimensional scenery gives the course depth, but the action stays on one plane, keeping the next obstacle and the rider's balance clearly connected.

Leaning changes the bike's pitch on the ground and in the air. A steep face may require the front wheel to rise first, while a landing asks the rider to arrive at the right angle. Restarting gives an immediate chance to try a different movement. Times and faults measure progress separately, so reaching the finish can be followed by an attempt to do it cleanly. Courses range from introductory tracks to extreme challenges, gradually demanding more precise control of the same small set of actions.

A level editor lets players construct courses from the tools used for the game's own tracks and share them with friends. Leaderboards and replays provide another way to study a difficult section, including the controller inputs behind a successful run. Skill games take the motorcycle into unusual challenges, such as towing a dangerous load or performing flips. Trials HD arrived during Microsoft's Summer of Arcade promotion and helped establish the series on consoles. Its repeated attempts work because each failure makes a small physical problem easier to recognise.
